name: print-social-german-course-post-with-hand-holding-city-collage
title: Mustard post: greyscale hand holding a vintage skyline, teal arch, curved quote and green paper banners
whatItIs: A grainy mustard 4:5 post with a black-and-white hand holding a cut-out old skyline and park, a teal arch and triangle behind, curved text along the arch, two blue denim star patches and two green torn-paper banners with cream caps.
whatItMeans: Surprising and hopeful; a city on a palm says 'your ticket to a world'.
techniques: Set text along a curved path around the image.
Use greyscale collage with two flat colour shapes.
Put the title on torn green paper banners.

vocabulary.definition: A ragged strip carrying a title.
A simple geometric shape behind a photo.
